consumer_obligations: DOWN-001 through DOWN-008 retained; local contribution only, not full fulfillment

requirements.title: Validate exact source correspondence
requirements.statement: Read bounded C1 ranges with matching workspace/occurrence/provenance and explicit hash verification scope.

requirements.title: Decode without losing native distinctions
requirements.statement: Preserve JSON type/lexeme/order/duplicate keys, CSV strings/missingness and explicit metadata-only/opaque states.

requirements.title: Retain derivation and assistance lineage
requirements.statement: Persist input references and decoder/feature/assistance versions; never count a transformation as independent evidence.

requirements.title: Separate descriptive role from evidential basis
requirements.statement: Keep roles/basis/rationale distinct, allow unclassified/multiple roles and verify only exact supplied nonempty quote bytes.

requirements.title: Preserve quantities and dimensional limits
requirements.statement: Retain original quantities/scales/units, expose unknown/unsupported units, reject incompatible/invalid cardinal submission and avoid ordinal arithmetic/zero filling.

requirements.title: Keep identity relation types distinct
requirements.statement: Separate registered source/content matches from explicit referent/part/replacement hypotheses; no uncertain equivalence closure or physical merge.

requirements.title: Version native retrieval features
requirements.statement: Store namespace/version/input/artifact identity with native statistics; do not present them as semantic embeddings or identity confidence.

requirements.title: Persist immutable retry-stable derivations
requirements.statement: Commit one original result per exact request/config/version fingerprint, returning conflicts for changed requests and preserving failed/partial outcomes.

requirements.title: Submit attributed candidates to C3 only
requirements.statement: Build reviewable candidate puts; preserve base revision, evidence, stable identities and optional C3 progress; expose no self-admission or automatic rebase.

requirements.title: Bound resources and normalize unsupported/failure states
requirements.statement: Enforce finite source/output/parse/association/storage/concurrency budgets, cooperative deadline and explicit errors without silently truncating complete data.

requirements.title: Preserve temporal scope and supplied context
requirements.statement: Keep source/receipt/commit/derivation times and caller-supplied model references separate; C2 does not invent world query/clock/action authority.

requirements.title: Isolate intake from interpretation dependencies
requirements.statement: Open C2/C3 lazily, use separate stores/read/proposal ports, reconcile cross-store submission outcome and preserve unavailable adapters.

cases.scenario: JSON lexical/order/type/duplicate-key fidelity and feature-version distinction
UTF-8 multibyte/nonempty absolute quote spans, invalid quote and invalid Unicode
CSV order/numeric strings/empty cells/no implicit header and no ordinal/zero conversion
PNG IHDR/WAV metadata-only limits, malformed formats and opaque unknown profiles
Whole versus selected-range hashes and returned workspace/occurrence identity faults
Decoder/storage/source failures leave native C1 available and partial/failed outcomes explicit
Role/basis independence and full declared imported-assistance lineage
Finite cardinal scalar, SI dimensions, incompatibility, unsupported/affine units and no conversion
Same source/payload versus physical referent/part/replacement hypotheses without transitive merge
Idempotent request/config conflicts, concurrency, stale C3 base and C3-committed/C2-receipt-lost retry
All owner port restrictions, candidate-only admission, optional progress and lazy separate store failures
Source epochs, late timestamps and unresolved two-year continuity without claimed long-duration validation

scope_note: New scoped implementation allocation. Does not change baseline requirement/case counts or qualify C3/C2.
